summary: Validated new Stripe recurring subscription feature end-to-end. Backend: POST /api/payments/checkout, GET /api/payments/status/{id}, PLAN_BY_LOOKUP mapping, auth guard, and payment_transactions persistence all pass (7/7 pytest). Frontend: full UI flow login → Plano → Assinar Intermediário → Stripe Checkout (sandbox) → pay with 4242... → /payment/success shows 'Assinatura ativada!' → GET /api/restaurant returns plan=intermediario, subscription_status=active, stripe_subscription_id set → Plano tab shows 'Assinatura ativa' badge and 'Plano atual' on Intermediário card. /payment/cancel page renders 'Pagamento cancelado'. Fallback polling of /payments/status (which hits Stripe directly and applies the subscription) works correctly without the webhook, as designed.
critical_code_review_comments: Stripe sandbox displays amounts in USD (US$20.43) due to the sandbox account default settings even though Price lookup_keys are in BRL. This is a Stripe sandbox cosmetic behavior, not a code bug — in production the merchant account will present BRL. No action needed.
subscription_data.metadata is set on checkout.Session.create — good; webhook customer.subscription.deleted path depends on this metadata.

/api/stripe/webhook relies on STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET being signed by the configured endpoint; in this preview env the webhook isn't delivered, but the /payments/status endpoint already provides an idempotent fallback (verified in test).
